name: earthenware
description: Earthenware: a sandboxed punch-card computer where a bypass hole reroutes cards through Z/30 arithmetic, so 5*9=15.
author: Joshua Almeida

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.js dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/chmod-bin.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test build-test/test/*.test.js
